basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 offers 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in an ANRF-sponsored research project. The project is in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee. The post lasts 1 year and pays Rs. 37000 + HRA. Only Indian nationals who hold the qualification printed in the notice can apply, and the notice asks for CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or selection through a national-level examination. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 30 October 2026, 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: A comprehensive security analysis of NIST Accordion mode proposals and their implications to has functions over Galois fields
Department of Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Roorkee

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The position is open to Indian nationals only. The notice lists the following under "Qualifications (Eligibility)": Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through any one of the following: a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. M.E./ MTech. in Information Tech./Computer Science & Engineering OR B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Sc. & Engineering / Information Technology/ Mathematics and Computing or equivalent OR Five years integrated BS-MS in Mathematics and Computing or equivalent. CGPA above 7.5 (or at least 75% marks). Experience in cryptography and cybersecurity along with a solid background in programming. For the full eligibility of the Junior Research Fellow post in each discipline, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists this work for the JRF: Rijndael-256 security analysis Accordion mode classical and quantum cryptanalysis with automated tools Accordion mode implementation and benchmarking in software and hardware platforms New 256-bit block cipher design Analysis of hash functions over Galois Fields

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Before you apply, make sure you meet the eligibility for the JRF position. Prepare the documents the notice asks for: your CV, degree certificates and experience certificates. Email your application with these documents to [email protected] , the Principal Investigator's address. Send it by 30 October 2026, 11:59 PM. This is the last date for applications to reach the office of the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. Shortlisted candidates will get the interview schedule by email. At the interview, candidates must bring their original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.text: SC/ST candidates will be given preference when qualifications and experience are equal. The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission. The selected candidate will join the position as soon as possible.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF). The post is in an ANRF-sponsored project in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026, 11:59 PM. Applications must reach the office of the Principal Investigator by email by then.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, with selection through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or a national-level examination. It also lists M.E./MTech., B.E./B.Tech. or a five-year integrated BS-MS in the named disciplines, and a CGPA above 7.5 (or at least 75% marks).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Roorkee JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments for the Junior Research Fellow are Rs. 37000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the JRF pay at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as Rs. 37000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF post?
faq.answer: Email your CV, degree certificates and experience certificates to [email protected] by 30 October 2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Roorkee JRF?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview and get the schedule by email. They must bring their original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the IIT Roorkee JRF position?
faq.answer: The position lasts 1 Year(s). The selected candidate will join as soon as possible.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the IIT Roorkee JRF interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the IIT Roorkee JRF lead to PhD admission?
faq.answer: The notice says the selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.
